title: Broken checkout in new API deploy
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the api component, the deployment‑related bug causing POST /orders failures, and the trigger as the 2.3.2 deploy.
root_cause: The deployment of api version 2.3.2 introduced a bug where a None value is passed to .strip() in order.py:142, causing 500 errors on POST /api/orders.
truth: api 2.3.2 introduced a regression in the order creation logic: a missing null check on the payment_token field causes an unhandled AttributeError on POST /api/orders, while read endpoints like /api/products still work.
